{"answer": "## Release summary

I reviewed the checkout project before and after the v1.9 → v2.0 upgrade, verified the updated version, and fixed the blocking issue found.

### What changed (v1.9 → v2.0)
| Area | v1.9 (`versions/before/server.py`, port 8081) | v2.0 (`checkout_app/`, port 8080) |
|---|---|---|
| Status version | `"1.9"` | `"2.0"` |
| Cart validation | empty cart only | empty cart **and** non-positive quantities |
| Payment method | hardcoded `"card"` | accepts `card` / `bank_transfer`, rejects others |
| Request size | unbounded | 64 KiB cap |
| Static web | none | serves `/` and `/app.js` |
| Malformed JSON | partially uncaught | caught → 400 |
